figures.caption: Figure 1: MER-Cross. Unlike previous tasks that focus on isolated speakers, we aim to predict the emotions of interlocutors. Thus, we can capture the emotions of both speakers in dynamic interaction scenarios.

Table 2: Baseline results (%) for MER-Cross. We report both unimodal and multimodal results. For the Train&Val set, we present five-fold cross-validation results. We then select the best-performingmodel based on the Train&Val set and report its performance on the test set. The grey column indicates the evaluation metric used for final ranking.
